rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for redundancy meaning losing a job because the position is no longer needed.

example.english: I lost my job in a redundancy because the position was no longer needed.
example.traditional: 我因為個職位取消咗而畀公司裁員。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jan1 wai6 go3 zik1 wai6 ceoi2 siu1 zo2 ji4 bei2 gung1 si1 coi4 jyun4

rows.note: Use this for something unnecessary or for needless repetition in ordinary, non-technical contexts.

example.english: You only needed to say it once; the rest is just redundancy.
example.traditional: 你講一次就夠，後面嗰啲只係多餘嘅嘢。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 jat1 ci3 zau6 gau3 hau6 min6 go2 di1 zi2 hai6 do1 jyu4 ge3 je5

rows.note: Use this technical term for deliberate duplication in systems or messages to improve reliability or error checking.

example.english: The system uses redundancy so it keeps running if one server fails.
example.traditional: 個系統加入冗餘，就算一部伺服器壞咗都仲運作到。
example.jyutping: go3 hai6 tung2 gaa1 jap6 jung2 jyu4 zau6 syun3 jat1 bou6 si6 fuk6 hei3 waai6 zo2 dou1 zung6 wan6 zok3 dou3
